CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeIDByResourceID] ( @ResourceID int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( With RS_Resource as ( Select 'R' SecurityAsset, ResourceID SecurityAssetID from reporting.Global_Resource RES where RES.ResourceID = @ResourceID and RES.[State] = 1 union all Select distinct 'G' SecurityAsset, RG.GroupID SecurityAssetID from reporting.Global_Resource RES inner join ResourceGroup RG on RG.ResourceID = RES.ResourceID where RES.ResourceID = @ResourceID and RES.[State] = 1 )
select r.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID from RS_Resource RES inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on RES.SecurityAssetID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = RES.SecurityAsset inner join responsibilitytyperelationrule r on (r.ID = rresource.RuleID) union select rr.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID from RS_Resource RES inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride on RES.SecurityAssetID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = RES.SecurityAsset inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) )
